title: Byte Packing
text: Construct data frames, 1 input, 1 output, {Output port (packed) data type} sets Data type for the packed output signal; {Input port (unpacked) data types (cell array)} sets the data types for the unpacked input signals and {Byte Alignment} sets the alignment of the input signal data types after. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: First of N input ports scalar | vector

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Output port containing packed data vector

params.name: Output port (packed) data type
params.values: Data type for the packed output signal uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Input port (unpacked) data types (cell array)
params.values: Data types for the unpacked input signals {’uint8’} (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Byte Alignment
params.values: Alignment of the input signal data types after packing 1 (default) | 2 | 4 | 8
